operation_title: This operation retrieves a list of NF Instances, and their offered services, currently registered in the NRF, satisfying a number of filter criteria.

query_parameters.name: target-nf-type
query_parameters.description: NF type of the NF Service Producer being discovered.

query_parameters.name: requester-nf-type
query_parameters.description: NF type of the NF Service Consumer invoking the service.

query_parameters.name: service-names
query_parameters.description: Array of service names to query; NRF returns NF profiles with at least one matching NF service, or all service names if omitted.

query_parameters.name: requester-nf-instance-fqdn
query_parameters.description: FQDN of the NF Service Consumer; used to return only NF profiles with allowedNfDomains matching the requester domain.

query_parameters.name: target-plmn-list
query_parameters.description: PLMN ID(s) of the target NF; if multiple are included, any listed PLMN matches.

query_parameters.name: requester-plmn-list
query_parameters.description: PLMN ID(s) of the requester NF.

query_parameters.name: target-nf-instance-id
query_parameters.description: Identity of the NF instance being discovered.

query_parameters.name: target-nf-fqdn
query_parameters.description: FQDN of the target NF instance being discovered.

query_parameters.name: hnrf-uri
query_parameters.description: API URI of the home NRF discovery service.

query_parameters.name: snssais
query_parameters.description: List of S-NSSAI served by the services being discovered.

query_parameters.name: plmn-specific-snssai-list
query_parameters.description: List of PLMN-specific S-NSSAI entries served by the NF service being discovered.

query_parameters.name: nsi-list
query_parameters.description: List of NSI IDs served by the services being discovered.

query_parameters.name: dnn
query_parameters.description: DNN for which NF services are discovered; may be included for BSF, SMF, or UPF.

query_parameters.name: smf-serving-area
query_parameters.description: Serving area of the SMF; may be included for UPF.

query_parameters.name: tai
query_parameters.description: Tracking Area Identity.

query_parameters.name: amf-region-id
query_parameters.description: AMF Region Identity.

query_parameters.name: amf-set-id
query_parameters.description: AMF Set Identity.

query_parameters.name: guami
query_parameters.description: Guami used to search for an appropriate AMF.

query_parameters.name: supi
query_parameters.description: SUPI of the requester UE to search for an appropriate NF.

query_parameters.name: ue-ipv4-address
query_parameters.description: IPv4 address of the UE for which a BSF needs to be discovered.

query_parameters.name: ip-domain
query_parameters.description: IPv4 address domain of the UE for which a BSF needs to be discovered.

query_parameters.name: ue-ipv6-prefix
query_parameters.description: IPv6 prefix of the UE for which a BSF needs to be discovered.

query_parameters.name: pgw-ind
query_parameters.description: Indicates whether a combined SMF/PGW-C or a standalone SMF needs to be discovered.

query_parameters.name: pgw
query_parameters.description: PGW FQDN received by the AMF from the MME to find the combined SMF/PGW.

query_parameters.name: gpsi
query_parameters.description: GPSI of the requester UE to search for an appropriate NF.

query_parameters.name: external-group-identity
query_parameters.description: External group identifier of the requester UE to search for an appropriate NF.

query_parameters.name: data-set
query_parameters.description: Data set to be supported by the NF to be discovered.

query_parameters.name: routing-indicator
query_parameters.description: Routing Indicator information used to route signaling with SUCI to an AUSF and UDM instance.

query_parameters.name: group-id-list
query_parameters.description: Identity of the group(s) of the NFs of the target NF type to be discovered.

query_parameters.name: dnai-list
query_parameters.description: Data network access identifiers.

query_parameters.name: upf-iwk-eps-ind
query_parameters.description: Indicates whether a UPF supporting interworking with EPS needs to be discovered.

query_parameters.name: chf-supported-plmn
query_parameters.description: PLMN ID that a CHF supports.

query_parameters.name: preferred-locality
query_parameters.description: Preferred target NF location.

query_parameters.name: access-type
query_parameters.description: Access type required to be supported by the target Network Function.

query_parameters.name: supported-features
query_parameters.description: Features required to be supported by the target Network Function; only applicable with a single service-name or when the target NF supports no service.

query_parameters.name: required-features
query_parameters.description: Features required to be supported by the target Network Function; one entry per service-name.

query_parameters.name: complex-query
query_parameters.description: Overrides the default logical relationship of query parameters.

query_parameters.name: limit
query_parameters.description: Maximum number of NFProfiles to be returned.

query_parameters.name: max-payload-size
query_parameters.description: Maximum response payload size in kilo octets.

query_parameters.name: pdu-session-types
query_parameters.description: PDU session type(s) requested to be supported by the target Network Function.

response_body.description: Result of the search over the list of registered NF Instances.
Used when the intermediate NRF redirects the service discovery request.
Error reason of the request message.
Returned if the NF Service Consumer is not allowed to discover the queried NF Service(s).
Error reason of the request message.

notes: NOTE 1: If this parameter is present and no AMF supporting the requested GUAMI is available due to AMF Failure or planned AMF removal, the NRF shall return in the response AMF instances acting as a backup for AMF failure or planned AMF removal respectively for this GUAMI. NOTE 2: If the combined SMF/PGW-C is requested to be discovered, the NRF shall return in the response the SMF instances registered with the SmfInfo containing pgwFqdn. NOTE 3: If a UPF supporting interworking with EPS is requested to be discovered, the NRF shall return in the response the UPF instances registered with the upfInfo containing iwkEpsInd set to true. NOTE 4: This attribute has a different semantic than what is defined in subclause 6.6.2 of 3GPP TS 29.500 [4], i.e. it is not used to signal optional features of the Nnrf_NFDiscovery Service API supported by the requester NF.
The default logical relationship among the query parameters is logical "AND", i.e. all the provided query parameters shall be matched, with the exception of the "preferred-locality" query.

The NRF may support the Complex query expression as defined in 3GPP TS 29.501 [2] for the NF Discovery service. If the "complexQuery" query parameter is included, then the logical relationship among the query parameters contained in "complexQuery" query parameter is as defined in 3GPP TS 29.571 [7].

A NRF not supporting Complex query expression shall reject a NF service discovery request including a complexQuery parameter, with a ProblemDetails IE including the cause attribute set to INVALID_QUERY_PARAM and the invalidParams attribute indicating the complexQuery parameter.
This method shall support the request data structures specified in table 6.1.3.2.3.1-2 and the response data structures and response codes specified in table 6.1.3.2.3.1-3.
No request body data structures are defined for this method.
There are no resource custom operations for the Nnrf_NFDiscovery service in this release of the specification.

constraints.statement: The request shall include target-nf-type.
The request shall include requester-nf-type.
The request shall include at least one service-name value when service-names is present.
The request shall include at least one target-plmn-list value when target-plmn-list is present.
The request shall include at least one requester-plmn-list value when requester-plmn-list is present.
The request shall include at least one snssais value when snssais is present.
The request shall include at least one plmn-specific-snssai-list value when plmn-specific-snssai-list is present.
The request shall include at least one nsi-list value when nsi-list is present.
The request shall include at least one group-id-list value when group-id-list is present.
The request shall include at least one dnai-list value when dnai-list is present.
The request shall include at least one required-features value when required-features is present.
The request shall include at least one pdu-session-types value when pdu-session-types is present.
The response shall use 200 OK with a SearchResult body on successful discovery.
The response shall use 307 Temporary Redirect when the intermediate NRF redirects the discovery request.
The response shall use 400 Bad Request with a ProblemDetails body for an invalid request message.
The response shall use 403 Forbidden with a ProblemDetails body when the NF Service Consumer is not allowed to discover the queried NF Service(s).
The response shall use 500 Internal Server Error with a ProblemDetails body for server-side request processing errors.
The request shall not include a request body.

If complex-query is included and the NRF does not support Complex query expression, the NRF shall reject the request with ProblemDetails cause INVALID_QUERY_PARAM and invalidParams identifying complex-query.
If supported-features is included, it is only applicable when exactly one service-name is provided or when the target NF supports no service.
If required-features is included, the request shall provide one required-features entry per service-name value.
The default logical relationship among query parameters shall be AND, except for preferred-locality.
If complex-query is included, the logical relationship among the query parameters inside complex-query shall follow the Complex Query expression rules.
The response body for 200 OK shall contain exactly one SearchResult object.
The SearchResult body shall include validityPeriod.
The SearchResult body may include nfInstances with zero or more NFProfile entries.
Each NFProfile in nfInstances shall include nfInstanceID, nfType, nfStatus, plmnList, sNssais, perPlmnSnssaiList, nsiList, and nfServices.
Each NFProfile.plmnList shall contain one or more PLMN IDs.
Each NFProfile.sNssais shall contain one or more S-NSSAI values.
Each NFProfile.perPlmnSnssaiList shall contain one or more PlmnSnssai entries.
Each PlmnSnssai shall include plmnId and sNssaiList.
Each PlmnSnssai.sNssaiList shall contain one or more S-NSSAI values.
Each NFProfile.nsiList shall contain one or more NSI identifiers.
Each NFProfile.nfServices shall contain one or more NFService entries.
The SearchResult body may include nrfSupportedFeatures as an optional field.
